usedFor: Gmail receives the emails and Freshservice runs your IT desk, so “New Email Arrives” can register senders through “Create Requestor”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Arrives” in Gmail, then “Create Requestor” in Freshservice
bestTemplate.why: Each sender who writes in gets a requester record, so tickets can be raised for them in Freshservice.

watchOut: “New Email Arrives” is polling, so “Create Requestor” follows a scheduled check; use its reply setting to skip repeat senders.
